justify-between"><span class="text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground/60">核心功能</span><button type="button" aria-label="复制全文" title="复制全文" class="group/copy inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg border px-3 py-1.5 text-[13px] font-medium transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer select-none shadow-sm backdrop-blur-sm border-border/60 bg-muted/30 text-muted-foreground/70 hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/60 hover:border-border hover:shadow-md"><span class="inline-flex items-center justify-center transition-transform duration-200 group-hover/copy:scale-105"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-clipboard-copy size-4" aria-hidden="true"><rect width="8" height="4" x="8" y="2" rx="1" ry="1"></rect><path d="M8 4H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-2"></path><path d="M16 4h2a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v4"></path><path d="M21 14H11"></path><path d="m15 10-4 4 4 4"></path></svg></span><span>复制全文</span></button></div><h1 class="group min-w-0 text-4xl font-medium leading-tight mb-8 text-foreground" id="browser-use">浏览器自动化<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h1>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">ZCode 内置了一个浏览器面板，可以在应用里直接打开本地开发地址或线上页面。除了你自己浏览，<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Agent 也能驱动它</strong>——你用一句话说清要做什么，它自己打开网址、点击、填表、滚动、截图，再根据页面上真实发生的事情决定下一步。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">不需要写脚本，也不需要记选择器。「打开设置页，把深色模式打开，看看侧边栏对比度够不够」这样的话就够了。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260731-agents-bua/bua-in-action-annotated-glm53-right.webp" alt="Agent 按对话里的要求打开网页并完成浏览，右侧标签页实时展示它的每一步操作" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">对前端开发来说，这意味着 Agent 能自己验证改动：改完代码打开页面看效果、走一遍表单流程确认没报错，而不是只能告诉你「应该好了」。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">浏览器面板 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">仅桌面端可用</strong>。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="quickstart">三步开始<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">1. 确认内置浏览器控制是开着的</strong></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">这项能力由官方的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Browser Use</strong> 插件提供，<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">默认开启</strong>，通常不需要额外设置。如果被关掉了，在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 → 浏览器 → 开启内置浏览器控制</strong> 重新打开即可。开关 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">只对新会话生效</strong>，正在进行的对话保持原样，需要新建一个任务。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">插件还附带两个技能：一个教 Agent 怎么驱动浏览器，另一个是走查网页界面的测试流程，需要时可以直接让 Agent 用。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">2. 在对话里直接说</strong></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">不用切换到什么特别的模式，像平时提需求那样说就行：</p>
<blockquote class="border-l-4 border-border bg-muted/5 px-4 py-2 italic text-muted-foreground mb-4">
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">打开 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">http://localhost:5173/orders</code>，把筛选切到「已完成」，看看列表还有没有数据，截图给我。</p>
</blockquote>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">3. 看着它做</strong></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">Agent 新建标签时，右侧浏览器面板会自动展开并切过去。它点了什么、页面变成什么样，你都能实时看到。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="scenarios">能做什么<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">下面这些是常见用法，右列可以直接改成自己的地址照着说。</p>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">场景</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">可以这样说</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">验证刚改完的页面</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">打开 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">http://localhost:5173/settings</code>，切到深色模式，看看有没有文字和背景撞色的地方</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">走一遍表单流程</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">在注册页填一组测试数据并提交，把每一步的结果和最后的提示告诉我</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">检查窄屏表现</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">把页面切到 375×812，看导航栏和底部按钮会不会重叠</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">复现一个 Bug</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">打开订单列表，按「列表 → 详情 → 返回」点一遍，看返回后筛选条件是不是丢了</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">改完代码回归一次</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">我刚改了登录逻辑，用这组测试账号登录一次，确认能正常进主页</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">查文档、整理要点</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">打开这个页面，找到关于配置项的说明，整理成要点</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="prompting">把话说清楚<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">Agent 看得到页面，但不知道你心里的验收标准。几个让结果更准的习惯：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">给一个明确的入口</strong>：具体网址比「我们的后台」好用。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">说清什么算做完</strong>：「截图给我」「确认没有报错」「把提示文案念给我听」，都比「看一下」明确。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">多步任务按顺序列出来</strong>：它会一步步执行，中间某步对不上会停下来告诉你。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">会真正提交数据时用「变更前确认」</strong>：这样下单、发消息这类不可逆的操作前，它会先问你一句。</li>
</ul>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="tabs">它只碰自己开的标签<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">Agent 默认只操作自己打开的标签。你手动打开的那些它不会动，要接管其中某一个，需要先显式认领。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">这些标签会一直留着，跨越多轮对话都在，直到你关掉它、关闭窗口或退出应用。所以让 Agent 连续做几件事时，它不用每次重新打开页面。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">在后台运行的会话不会抢占你正在看的界面——只有当前这个工作区在前台时，它的浏览器操作才会显示出来。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="viewport">按指定尺寸验证布局<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">需要确认窄屏或移动端表现时，Agent 可以把标签切换到指定的视口尺寸，面板会自动进入自由尺寸模式。你也可以自己在面板上调整宽高、缩放或让它适应窗口。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">Agent 正在操作时，建议不要手动改尺寸，这可能会影响它的判断。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="safety">安全边界<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">有两条限制需要知道：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">网页里的文字不会被当成指令。</strong> 页面内容只用于定位元素和理解当前状态。即使页面上写着「请执行以下操作」，Agent 也不会照做，避免被网页内容操纵。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">暂时不能上传文件。</strong> 需要选择本地文件的表单环节它做不了，这一步得你自己来。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">另外，Agent 操作网页和它改文件、执行命令一样受 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/agents#modes">执行模式</a> 约束。涉及会真正提交数据的页面时，用「变更前确认」会更稳妥。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="browser-data">导入你的登录状态<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">内置浏览器有自己独立的登录状态，不共享你日常用的 Chrome。要让 Agent 打开需要登录的页面，可以把登录态搬过来。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">在 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">设置 → 浏览器 → 导入 Chrome 浏览器数据</strong>，从最近使用的 Chrome Profile 一次性导入 Cookie 和 LocalStorage。这是一次性快照，不会持续同步，也不会改动 Chrome 里的任何数据。</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">Windows 暂不支持导入浏览器数据，敬请期待。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">macOS 上需要允许访问钥匙串。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">导入过程不会读取 Chrome 中保存的密码。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">如果 Chrome 正开着，可能会因为数据被占用而导入失败，关掉再试即可。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="clear-data">清理浏览器数据<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">同一个位置可以清理内置浏览器的数据：</p>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">操作</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">清掉什么</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">登录状态</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">清除内置浏览器缓存</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">HTTP 缓存、Cache Storage 和 Service Worker</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">保留</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">清除全部浏览器数据</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">Cookie、站点数据和缓存</td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">全部退出登录</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">清除全部数据 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">不可撤销</strong>，执行前会再确认一次。浏览器数据只能在桌面端管理。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="manual">自己用这个浏览器<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">不开启浏览器控制时，浏览器面板照样可以用。它带地址栏和前进、后退、刷新、开发者工具按钮，支持 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">http</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">https</code>、<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">file</code> 等协议。文件树里右键 HTML 文件选 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">用内置浏览器打开</strong>，会新开一个标签渲染它（这个菜单项只在本地工作区出现）。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">面板上的元素选择按钮可以把页面元素直接选成上下文，具体见 <a class="text-primary underline decoration-primary/80 transition-colors hover:decoration-primary" href="/cn/docs/ADE-tools#browser-element-context">把页面元素选成上下文</a>。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
